'''Vexar''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]<ref name="FJ" /> in the [[Vexar system/Legends|eponymous star system]], located in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Vexar was orbited by at least three [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including a [[Third moon of Vexar|rocky moon]] that could just barely support [[Human/Legends|human]] life.<ref name="FJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Vexar was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]'', which was written by [[Christie Golden]]<ref name="FJ" /> and released in [[2011]].<ref name="Amazon">{{RandomHouseOld|url=book/68770/star-wars-fate-of-the-jedi-ascension-by-christie-golden|text=Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi: Ascension}}</ref> Later, the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|online appendix]] to the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the [[Vexar system/Legends|Vexar star system]] and the planet itself in grid square S-4.<ref name="EAOC" />
